question: NDP at FC = GDP at FC minus _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**depreciation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **NDP at FC**

 
 
• The **revenue **that the factors receive in the form of **wages, profits, rent, interest**, etc. is known as the **Net Domestic Product at Factor Cost (NDP at FC)**. 
 
 
 
• **GDP**
 
 
• The **total value added in a particular economy** is measured by the **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**.
 
• The value-added, sometimes referred to as **intermediate consumption**, **is the difference between the price of the goods and services produced and the price of the goods and services required to produce them**.
 
 
 
• Formula to **calculate NDP FC**
 
 
• It is computed by **deducting depreciation from the gross domestic product (GDP)** and it is represented as;
 
 

** NDP at FC = GDP at FC - depreciation**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• One of the primary indicators of economic growth that the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) reports on a quarterly basis is NDP, along with GDP, gross national income (GNI), gross domestic product (GNP), and disposable income, and personal income. 
 
• Components of NDP are** NDP at Factor Cost = NDP as Market Price-Indirect Cases+Subsidies**.
 
• **Gross National Product (GNP)**, which is determined without depreciation or the consumption of capital utilized in the manufacturing process, **is the total market value of the final goods and services produced by a country's economy during a specified time period **(usually a year).
 
• **Gross National Income (GNI) is the entire amount of money a nation receives from its citizens and enterprises**, whether they are located in the country or abroad.
